title: In JetBrains TeamCity before 2026.1.3, 2025.11.7 stored XSS in the Promote build dialog was possible (CVE-2026-132242)
description: A stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in JetBrains TeamCity versions prior to 2026.1.3 and 2025.11.7 in the Promote build dialog. This vulnerability allows an attacker with limited privileges to inject malicious scripts that can be executed in the context of other users. The vulnerability has a high severity rating with a CVSS score of 7.6.
